name: Best Mart 360 Holdings Limited
summary: Best Mart 360 Holdings Limited is an investment holding company that runs chain stores selling snack and leisure foods under the Best Mart 360 and FoodVille brands. The stores operate in Hong Kong, Macau and mainland China. Products include chocolates, confectionery, bakery items, biscuits, cereals, noodles, frozen and canned food, nuts and dried fruit.
